name: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings
summary: A library welcomes magical works for its collection. Your discoveries help expand its knowledge.

sections.title: The Collection
sections.body: The library's keeper thanks you as its collection grows through your efforts. More magical works may add to its knowledge, and the keeper welcomes them for the library.

faq.answer: The library welcomes magical works that may benefit its collection.
Librarians gather such works in Stormwind and in the Undercity.
Your efforts expand the library's knowledge.

attribution: In-game quest text: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings
